data.name: Harinder
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit language. Hari is the name of Vishnu, the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti. Indra is the god of rain, thunder and lightning in Hinduism. Combining the names, Harinder means 'Hari's radiance' or 'Indra's radiance'. This name is used to honor the divine power of Vishnu or Indra.
